decisions.reason: The air quality module had its own page and was announced as a new capability of the building-block system, and indoor air quality monitoring stayed in demand, so the firm's visible commitment and the module's fit with its platform expansion favor keeping it.
As the 3.0 successor to a long-standing basic measurement module, it is part of the hardware-generation path the firm has announced, so dropping it would contradict its own replacement decision.

The CAN bus interface broadens the platform's connectivity for automation and industrial customers, a niche the firm has committed to, and its development and firmware investment argues for keeping it.

The CO2 sensor module was presented on its own page and gained relevance with ventilation monitoring, so its costly sensor integration and public positioning make the firm likely to keep it, though a newer version could eventually replace it.
